data.title: 青山七海 · 樱花庄厨房的破晓早餐颠锅
data.description: 清晨樱花庄宽敞的公共厨房内，晨光穿透大玻璃窗洒在不锈钢料理台上。七海系着粉白格纹围裙一手熟练颠锅一手撒调味料，高马尾利落摇晃，元气满满准备全员早餐。
data.location: spacious rustic kitchen of Sakurasou dorm with steaming pots and sunlit stainless countertops
data.action: standing at stove tossing vegetables in a frying pan, seasoning food with poised culinary skill, hair ponytail bouncing, bright determined smile
data.lighting: 朝阳晨光穿透高窗的逆光辉映与热气缭绕
data.promptProse: Nanami expertly tosses vegetables in a sizzling pan inside the sun-drenched Sakurasou kitchen, her high ponytail swinging as she cooks breakfast.
data.animaCaption: Bright morning light and cooking steam swirl around her gingham apron as she finishes the dish.
